Commands.Text: /shout Feeling a lil luck? Test your luck over at our gamba table with <dealer>!
/p  Welcome <_p_>. Thank you for joining us. Bet ranges goes from 50k to 500k. VIP can go up to 1m. - I do banking. - Do you need the rules for BJ? 
/p The goal of Blackjack is to beat the Dealer's hand without going over 21.
/p • Face cards (11,12,13) are worth 10. 1 are Aces (1 or 11). Everthing else number value.
/p • To "Hit" is to ask for another card. To "Stand" is to hold your total and end your turn.
/p • "Push" If you Tie with the dealer, you have the choice to Push your bet to the next hand or receive your gil back.
/p • Double Down is like a Hit, only the bet is doubled and you only get one more card.
/p • Split can be done when you have two of the same card, the pair is split into two hands. You can only split once.
/p • If the Player and Dealer get a Natural Blackjack you get Pushed.
/p • Dealer stands at 17, and dealers choice on a soft 17 to stand or not.
